case.scope_warning: First experiment reports operator duration; second/third report MTE2 pipeline time. Do not sum or directly compare as a single series or claim final operator duration. Results are author reports from development-preview documentation.

evidence_chain.claim: Tiling computed from tensor dtype/layout/shape and optional buffer settings using GetTiling; hand-written TM/TN/TK examples are not device-generated TCubeTiling.
Host Tiling can query available L1/L0/UB memory using PlatformAscendC.GetCoreMemSize; physical resource sizes are device/version specific.
On a specified Atlas A2 Matmul workload, increasing Cube cores 4 to 20 was associated with operator time 12045 -> 2532 microseconds.
Changing base tile 64x64x256 to 128x256x64 was associated with MTE2 time 2452 -> 808 microseconds.
CFG_MDL bulk transfer was associated with MTE2 time 808 -> 591 microseconds.
msopprof reports pipeline and roofline diagnostic output; measurement columns and applicability depend on product/version.
Version 351x architecture documents specific alignment values; using them as generic A2/910B/310P limits is ungrounded.

applicability: Research evidence to upgrade educational web exposition, not a claim of already optimized user's own LLM.
